payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court

condition.question: Has the image background been changed into a recognizable basketball court?
condition.criteria: The edited background visibly depicts a basketball court, identifiable from the background as a playing area with court context or markings, or from basketball equipment integrated into a visible playing surface. Judge the background as a whole: a dark or featureless upper area does not by itself make the setting ambiguous when a visible playing surface and court markings, together with basketball equipment, clearly establish a court. Basketball-related objects against an otherwise ambiguous background alone are not enough. A sparse or stylized court can fully satisfy the endpoint when the background as a whole is clearly recognizable as a basketball court.
condition.binding: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: determine whether the background in EDITED is a recognizable basketball court rather than the original background. Judge the background as a whole, including the visible playing surface, court markings, and basketball equipment in context. Do not require broad court context or a uniformly detailed background when the visible features establish the court identity; do not treat basketball objects alone against an ambiguous background as sufficient.
condition.source_quote: Change the background into a basketball court
condition.endpoint: The background is visibly recognizable as a basketball court.
condition.necessity: Changing the background into a basketball court is the explicit requested edit.
condition.zero_when: The background shows no requested change toward depicting a basketball court; unrelated edits do not count.
condition.half_when: The background has concrete basketball-court cues, but the background as a whole remains genuinely ambiguous or incomplete as a playing court—for example, basketball equipment appears without enough visible playing-surface or court context to establish the setting.
condition.full_when: The background as a whole is clearly recognizable as a basketball court from visible court context, markings, or basketball equipment integrated with a playing surface. Sparse or stylized context is acceptable when the court identity is clear; a dark or featureless area elsewhere in the background does not prevent full achievement when the visible playing surface and court cues establish the setting. Natural variation in lighting, texture, or photographic appearance is acceptable.
